chars.NARRATOR: a Moroccan woman in her mid-20s with long wavy dark brown hair, wearing a mustard-yellow oversized hoodie and light blue jeans
chars.MOM: a Moroccan woman in her late 50s, wearing a burgundy velvet djellaba and a cream headscarf
chars.SISTER: a Moroccan woman about 30 with straight black hair in a low ponytail, wearing an emerald-green satin blouse and black trousers
chars.HUSBAND: a Moroccan man about 35 with a short trimmed beard and slicked-back hair, wearing a tight white polo shirt and beige chinos

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from a half-open doorway, head-to-waist: MOM stands in a Moroccan salon with patterned banquettes, holding a phone to her ear, smiling slyly and lowering her eyes, her free hand on her chest as if swearing a promise she does not mean. Warm evening light, 2D cartoon style, calm background at the edges.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Head-to-waist: NARRATOR in her small Casablanca apartment holds a phone to her ear, frowning firmly and shaking her head, refusing an invitation, the other hand raised as if saying no. 2D cartoon style, calm background.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Head-to-waist: NARRATOR sits on the edge of her bed with the phone at her ear, unsure and hesitant, biting her lip, looking down as she is being convinced. A handbag lies next to her. 2D cartoon style, calm background.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Seen from behind NARRATOR's shoulder as she freezes in the doorway of a big Moroccan family salon: SISTER and HUSBAND sit together on the banquette with tea glasses, looking up at her calmly. NARRATOR's face in profile is shocked, mouth open. 2D cartoon style, subjects in the centre.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Head-to-waist in a Moroccan salon: SISTER stands with arms crossed and chin raised, demanding an apology, pointing at the floor; NARRATOR faces her, wide-eyed and offended, hand on her chest. 2D cartoon style, calm background.
